name: Ezhuthaani Expanded Tamil Learner Dictionary — Core
description: A bidirectional Tamil-English learner lexicon designed for Ezhuthaani dictionary search. Search Tamil to get English meaning and a Tamil example; search English to get Tamil and the same contextual example.
important_note: This is a curated learner core, not an exhaustive dictionary of every Tamil inflected form, dialect, technical term, or literary word. For production, combine it with a larger licensed lexical source and keep provenance per entry.
